{ "source": "{% comment %} Outcome Testing page shell. Every portal page extends this and fills the "content" block. Usage: extends 'OT Layout', then a block named content. Header, navigation and footer come from the site's header/footer templates; outcome-testing.css restyles those to Ascot Lloyd brand values. {% endcomment %} {% comment %} Roundo is the brand's single primary font (brand/ typography sheet), served from Fontshare, the source the sheet itself names. Weights are Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600. The stylesheet carries a version querystring so a browser holding the previous file picks up changes without a hard refresh. Bump it on EVERY change to outcome-testing.css, not only a material one - a browser holding the old file is not told what changed, and the deploy succeeds either way, so the omission looks exactly like a CSS rule that does not work. That is how a border fix for the remediation Reason and Notes fields shipped to DEV twice on 2026-09-11 and was reported both times as not showing. {% endcomment %}
